scope: Read-only production-code audit plus fresh synthetic declared-input production-function probes. Only audit cache files written; no source modifications, full suites, native CAD, remote providers or hardware execution.
conclusion: HS has real reusable import/composition/contract-assessment primitives; it is not a general automatic reverse-engineer-and-transform system for arbitrary junk. The widest fresh input flexibility is explicit, source-bound contracts and connectivity. Catalog composition executes topology changes for supported families; undocumented donor interfaces remain unresolved.

production_boundaries.finding: Known catalog IDs compose graph; missing IDs filtered at609. Many per-device branches including HC-SR04 and named drivers constrain generality.
Stable IDs and aliases,component/pin/net projection,unresolved identities,proposed authority. No substitute selection or hardware regeneration occurs in this function.
Source hash and JSON pointer must match declared contract; materials and wiring bound to same project revision. Assess/export does not change physical device.

Complete-net DC ranges,current budgets,wire ampacity/insulation,single-driver high/low windows,ground refs,role compatibility. Missing facts unresolved. Signal timing/loading/protocol,voltage drop,transients,fuses,connector mating and full coverage explicitly excluded.
Custom board5..500mm,up to300parts,curated kinds/packages and optional dimensions. Typed markings/readings remain user data,not automatic identification,pinout or measured validation.

Persisted functional salvage capability supports arbitrary board/block IDs. Unknown identity remains external_unresolved; explicit recognized catalog ID is declared only; offline legacy mode behaves differently.

Firmware candidate authorization needs verified status,no blockers,accepted measured/observed max voltage,active level,controller pin,and interface_complete. It does not by itself prove motor/current/timing/protocol/thermal safety.
Binding updates require explicit evidence_id,method,producer. The update mutates the plan/evidence and candidate-authorized-for-compile flags; it does not build/flash a binary or test the donor.
Alternative MPNs are catalog/family/alias suggestions,not demonstrated drop-in compatibility or automatic rewiring.
Exact catalog ID scoped to InvenTree capture,manufacturer+MPN,or identical declared specification. Conditions,stock allocations,freshness/expiry and simulation checked; no orders/reservation.
Many formats retained/classified,not necessarily deeply parsed. PDF/images/firmware/archive imports are inventory-only; upload never exceeds declared authority.
Registered STEP execution explicitly skipped: no callable bounded STEP parser in this generic stored-source path; native case scripts are a separate capability.

Optional kicad-happy sidecar reads KiCad/Gerber,hashes inputs,normalizes findings and can block release policy; authority observed and cannot authorize release. It does not implement an adapter/redesign.

user_effects: Tweak known modules or explicit pin/rating contracts and HS can regenerate topology,cut lists and bounded acceptance results.
For an unfamiliar donor,bring exact identity,pin numbering/view,voltage/current/signal limits,physical dimensions and traceable evidence; a photo/marking/freeform statement is not enough.
A supplied adapter/module can alter checked topology; HS does not generally invent and verify the necessary translator,driver,mechanical fixture or complete working firmware from arbitrary junk.
Generated graphs,KiCad-capable plans,Wiring ZIPs and passing bounded checks remain digital evidence; no physical working-device claim follows.
